scope: Mechanism and one-turn opportunity cost; six hand-constructed roots mirrored by seat, five simultaneous enemy planter responses crossed with two own choices. Branches have no probability weights. No next-turn game value, search labels or policy-strength claim.
conditions: Standard rules, all four tree-adjacent cardinal cells start at 25 carbon; all other cells empty. The tree can earn in the same step as seizure. Only the defended side decides between screen and bank. Banked cargo is liquid cash this turn; cargo may survive a screen.
